hypotheses.A0_heads_recompose_attention: Summed head writes reproduce the native attention write with maximum relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.A1_four_fixed_heads_recover_attention_op: A discovery-selected fixed four-head subset recovers at least 80 percent of the attention-dependent operator-sketch effect at every layer.
hypotheses.A2_four_heads_are_nontrivially_selected: The selected four-head subset exceeds the p95 of all equal-size subsets by at least 0.03 recovery in at least four layers.
hypotheses.A3_fixed_four_approaches_example_oracle: Fixed four-head recovery is within 0.10 of the per-example four-head oracle at every layer.
hypotheses.A4_two_heads_are_insufficient: Fixed two-head recovery remains below 0.80 in at least four layers.
hypotheses.A5_single_heads_have_supervised_roles: For at least half of competent features, a validation-selected single head reaches within 0.05 AUROC of the complete operator state on held-out FineWeb in at least one layer.
hypotheses.A6_source_roles_are_split_stable: At every layer, same-head discovery/evaluation source-role cosine exceeds the matched shuffled-head p95.
